elements.name: Boundary (presentation: Swing screens)
elements.responsibility: Screens for login, registration, dashboard, report creation, review, status update, notes and monitoring; enter Control mostly through the SystemServicesController facade

elements.name: Control (application: use-case controllers)
elements.responsibility: One controller per use case; SystemServicesController facade owns them and passes Map data to the domain services

elements.name: Entity (domain: entities and services)
elements.responsibility: JPA-annotated domain entities plus ReportService and UserService, which call Database directly

elements.name: Database (persistence: JPA access)
elements.responsibility: Generic persistence access over JPA/Hibernate to MySQL

elements.name: User (citizen or municipal operator)
elements.responsibility: Person using the Swing screens; citizen or municipal operator

concern_details.detail: How do these parts collaborate to provide the main system functionalities?
